About

Your LinkedIn DM Appointment Setter builds sales pipeline through LinkedIn conversations. It researches prospect profiles, sends targeted connection requests, runs warm DM sequences that feel personal, and books calls directly on your calendar. This is the exact playbook that companies pay $3-5K/mo to virtual assistants for — except this employee does it 24/7, personalizes at scale, and never misses a follow-up. If your business runs on booked calls, this is the most valuable employee on your team.

Research and identify 50+ ICP-fit prospects on LinkedIn daily

Track connection accept rates, reply rates, and meetings booked

A/B test DM templates and follow-up cadences weekly
